name: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: América Móvil, S.A.B. de C.V., founded in 2000 and headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico, operates as a prominent international telecommunications provider, serving clients across Latin America and globally. The company delivers a broad spectrum of communication solutions, encompassing both wireless and fixed-line voice services for local, domestic, and international calls, in addition to essential network interconnection. Its comprehensive data services include data center management, administration, and hosting for residential and corporate clientele. América Móvil also specializes in value-added offerings such as internet access, diverse messaging solutions, wireless entertainment, and advanced corporate communication tools, covering data transmission, email, instant messaging, content streaming, and interactive applications. Furthermore, the company provides specialized mobile services like wireless security, mobile payment systems, machine-to-machine (M2M) connectivity, mobile banking, virtual private network (VPN) access, video calling, and other personal communication services. Beyond core connectivity, its portfolio includes residential broadband, comprehensive IT solutions tailored for businesses of all sizes, and subscription-based cable and satellite television. The company also retails telecommunications equipment, accessories, and computers. Ancillary services include telephone directories, call center support, advertising, media services, and software development. A key offering is the direct distribution of video, audio, and various media content from providers to end-users over the internet. América Móvil's products and services are marketed under well-known brands such as Telcel, Telmex Infinitum, and A1. Distribution is managed through an extensive network of retailers and service centers for individual customers, complemented by a dedicated sales force catering to corporate clients.
